inicio.ReneDesc: The name Cogito Lab is inspired by the famous expression of French philosopher René Descartes, “Cogito, ergo sum” — “I think, therefore I am.” The idea reflects the importance of thought, reflection, and the pursuit of knowledge, principles that guide the laboratory's vision.
inicio.descricao: Cogito Lab is a space dedicated to research, experimentation, and the development of ideas. The laboratory brings together researchers interested in exploring different fields of knowledge, fostering collaboration and the creation of new perspectives.
inicio.missao: Our mission is to encourage research and critical thinking, transforming ideas and questions into knowledge, experiments, and solutions. Cogito Lab aims to create a collaborative environment where researchers can investigate, share, and develop new ideas.
inicio.instituicoes: The laboratory brings together researchers affiliated with different academic and research institutions, promoting collaboration across different fields and perspectives.

cardPesquisas.texto: Investigates the use of Artificial Intelligence, particularly Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI-assisted programming tools, to support software development activities. Topics include code generation, bug fixing, software maintenance, code review, refactoring, prompt engineering, AI agents for software engineering, and the evaluation of the quality, correctness, security, and usefulness of AI-generated software artifacts.
cardPesquisas.temas: Topics: Code generation, Bug fixing, Software maintenance, Code review, Refactoring, Prompt engineering, AI agents for Software Engineering, Evaluation of AI-generated code, Software security and correctness
cardPesquisas.projetos: Projects focused on the development of AI tools for programming, automated code generation and repair, and intelligent agents to support software developers.
cardPesquisas.resultados: Scientific publications, software tools, AI models, datasets, prototypes, and other artifacts related to the use of AI in software development.
cardPesquisas.titulo2: Software Quality, Technical Debt and Refactoring
cardPesquisas.texto2: Studies techniques to understand, assess, and improve the internal quality, maintainability, and evolution of software systems. Topics include technical debt, code smells, test smells, software maintainability, code quality metrics, software evolution, refactoring, automated refactoring, and the use of AI to identify and address quality problems.
cardPesquisas.temas2: Topics: Technical debt, Code smells, Test smells, Software maintainability, Code quality metrics, Software evolution, Refactoring, Automated refactoring, AI applied to software quality
cardPesquisas.projetos2: Projects focused on software quality analysis, software problem detection, technical debt management, and the automation of refactoring processes.
cardPesquisas.resultados2: Scientific publications, code analysis tools, datasets, quality metrics, automated refactoring techniques, and other artifacts related to software quality.
cardPesquisas.texto3: Focuses on methods, techniques, and tools for improving software testing and increasing the reliability of software systems. Topics include automated test generation, test code quality, test coverage, fault detection, test smells, static and dynamic analysis, test code refactoring, reliability assessment, and AI-assisted software testing.
cardPesquisas.temas3: Topics: Automated test generation, Test code quality, Test coverage, Fault detection, Test smells, Static and dynamic analysis, Test code refactoring, Reliability assessment, AI-assisted software testing
cardPesquisas.projetos3: Projects related to test automation, test case generation, fault detection, and the application of Artificial Intelligence to software testing.
cardPesquisas.resultados3: Scientific publications, testing tools, frameworks, datasets, test cases, automated techniques, and reliability analysis tools.
cardPesquisas.texto4: Investigates software systems whose behavior depends on combinations of features, resources, devices, or execution contexts. Topics include software variability, feature and resource interactions, configurable systems, mobile applications, Internet of Things (IoT) systems, interaction failures, context-aware software, resource-constrained environments, and techniques for detecting and correcting failures in such systems.
cardPesquisas.temas4: Topics: Software variability, Feature and resource interactions, Configurable systems, Mobile applications, Internet of Things (IoT), Interaction failures, Context-aware software, Resource-constrained environments, Failure detection and correction
cardPesquisas.projetos4: Projects involving configurable systems, mobile applications, IoT devices, and techniques for identifying and correcting failures related to different configurations and contexts.
cardPesquisas.resultados4: Scientific publications, tools, datasets, mobile applications, prototypes, analysis techniques, and solutions for configurable and IoT systems.
cardPesquisas.titulo5: Collaborative Software Development and Empirical Software Engineering
cardPesquisas.texto5: Studies how software is developed and evolved by teams, with emphasis on evidence obtained from real software projects and developers. Topics include merge conflicts, developer coordination, version control systems, collaborative development, software repositories, mining software repositories, software evolution, human and social aspects of software engineering, and empirical methods for understanding software development practices.
cardPesquisas.temas5: Topics: Merge conflicts, Developer coordination, Version control systems, Collaborative development, Software repositories, Mining software repositories, Software evolution, Human and social aspects, Empirical methods in Software Engineering
cardPesquisas.projetos5: Projects that analyze software repositories, development practices, collaboration between developers, and the evolution of real-world systems.
cardPesquisas.resultados5: Scientific publications, datasets, software repository mining tools, empirical analyses, case studies, and other research outputs based on real-world projects.
cardPesquisas.texto6: Investigates how scientific and technological knowledge can be transformed into innovation, new ventures, and socioeconomic impact. Topics include innovation ecosystems, academic entrepreneurship, startups, spin-offs, ideation, incubation, acceleration, technology transfer, intellectual property, innovation management, collaboration between universities, industry, and government, open innovation, and regional development through science, technology, and entrepreneurship.
cardPesquisas.temas6: Topics: Innovation ecosystems, Academic entrepreneurship, Startups, Spin-offs, Ideation, Incubation, Acceleration, Technology transfer, Intellectual property, Innovation management, Open innovation, Regional development
cardPesquisas.projetos6: Projects focused on creating startups and spin-offs, transferring technologies, developing innovative solutions, and strengthening collaboration between universities, companies, and government.
cardPesquisas.resultados6: Scientific publications, startups, spin-offs, technologies, software, patents, business models, prototypes, and other innovation initiatives.
